issue: gonzalez addendum — the half-move left by the four-values apply
note: This file IS the scope. relocate-pool-rows-by-list.cjs touches exactly these ids and nothing else. Every entry here is a REPOINT (hobbyiqCardId patched in place), never a partition move: these rows are ALREADY in the right partition.
rulings: The four-values apply was a HALF MOVE. It relocated 44 base autos' cardId to bowman:cpa-jg:base:auto but left every one of their hobbyiqCardId values on the refractor num-499 slug. The exact-pool reader ORs cardId and hobbyiqCardId, so all 44 still pull into the refractor pool and still pollute the holding's price.

The cause is a caller-side equality guard, not the relocate helper: relocate-pool-rows-by-list.cjs rewrites hobbyiqCardId only `if (String(doc0.hobbyiqCardId) === from)`. For all 44 rows the list's fromCardId was the bowman-CHROME slug while the stored hobbyiqCardId was the bowman slug, so the guard was false 44 times out of 44 and the field was never rewritten.
A repoint is the right verb here and a relocate would be wrong: the partition is already correct, and re-running these ids as moves would upsert onto occupied addresses.
The one genuine /499 refractor in the source partition KEEPS its hobbyiqCardId. Its two identity halves already agree and are already right.

Duplicated ids — 5 three-way and 3 cross-partition pairs — are deliberately OUT of this list. This lane patches one document in place; collapsing a duplicate pair is the dedup lane's job and doing it here would silently lose a sale.
